limitations: Transcription status: pending line-by-line verification. No paraphrase in the chapters is represented as a verbatim quotation of the handwritten pages.
Step flows and system diagrams are teaching sequences. Arrows describe a teaching order, not necessarily historical causation or a literal execution path.
The full interactive timeline is a later batch. Timelines are represented in the design system only; no timeline page is advertised here as completed.
Private material is excluded by count only: 2 privacy-excluded internship/onboarding items and 4 former-employer records never appear in this site. No detail about them is published.
Research edition, not a certified history: claims rest on the preserved notes plus labelled editorial synthesis, and verification remains in progress.
